Are You Researching an Architecture Dissertation?

Choosing the best dissertation topic is a crucial first step in selecting the right topic when studying architecture and planning your dissertation. At Tutors India, we have compiled a list of innovative and research-based architecture dissertation titles for students in India at undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctorate levels. The titles below are aligned with contemporary architectural debates and issues – the creative learning process in design studios; sustainable development; innovations in the curriculum.

Below is a list of dissertation topic ideas to provide inspiration:

Assessing Transitional Situations when Educating Architects in the Studio Context Mind Maps, Models, Sketches and Relating Them to the Conceptual Design Development Process Peer and Self-Assessment Processes Early in the Design Process: A Critical Review Research and Schematic Design: Curriculum Revision in the Indian Context Cognitive Styles of Learning and Individualized Instructional Methods in Architectural Design Design Outputs and Student Contentment: The Interface of Understandings of Bridging Process Strategies Adaptive Reuse and Cultural Continuity when Reimagining Public Spaces in Indian Cities Sustainable Form of Urban, Climate Adapted Design Approaches in Tier II Cities Blogging, Digital facilitation, Design Thinking and Creativity within Undergraduate Architecture Architectural Judgement, The Ethical, Aesthetic, and Reflection in the Studio If any of those ideas were of interest to you, that alone is a great starting point! When you are ready to move forward, check out our “How to Write a Dissertation Title” article which will help you come up with a focused and meaningful title for your final thesis with clarity, and academic relevance.
